command: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts apps/web/tests/queue-actions.e2e.ts -t 'edits and removes exact occurrences and preserves Queue across button stop' --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose
surface: built Web client through a real Playwright browser and loopback scaffold
userAction: submit a second message while the first turn is held
scope: The measurement starts at Enter and ends when the user-visible submission status is available.
This proves local admission/status feedback only; it does not measure Reflex route decision, remote first byte, or full answer time.
The held request is a deterministic transport fixture for the UI boundary, not a provider-latency claim.
